Prufrock is perfectly named

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-18T10:18:45+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2122997935486996569; média: 1 kép]
Elon Musk just shared the literary inspiration behind The Boring Company's massive tunnel-boring machines

Each machine is named after a classic work of literature:

• Godot - Waiting for Godot by Samuel Beckett
• Line-Storm - A Line-Storm Song by Robert Frost
• Prufrock - The Love Song of J. Alfred Prufrock by T. S. Eliot

Massive machines designed to dig tunnels beneath cities, with names inspired by some of the greatest works of poetry and theater

A little literature behind some seriously impressive engineering
